summary: Generates positioned, rotated rectangles with rounded corners, optional borders, independent fill/background colors, and antialiasing.

key_params.name: sizeunit
key_params.note: Pixels or normalized fraction units for size.

key_params.name: centerunit
key_params.note: Pixels or normalized fraction units for center.

key_params.name: borderoffset
key_params.note: Border offset applied to the effective corner radius.

key_params.name: softness
key_params.note: Blend amount from background into shape.

key_params.name: swaporder
key_params.note: Swap input and rectangle order when compositing.

common_gotchas: Center value 0,0 means perfectly centered, not lower-left.
Unit menus strongly change interpretation of size, center, border width, corner radius, and softness.
Border Offset changes the effective radius using the documented radius plus offset times border width relationship.
Background, border, and fill colors have independent alpha controls.
Use antialiasing for clean UI and mask shapes, but account for softened edge pixels.
key_concepts: Generates positioned and rotated procedural rectangles with optional rounded corners.
Fill, border, and background colors have independent alpha controls.
Size, center, border, corner radius, and softness can use different unit modes.
Output-page controls can composite the rectangle over an input TOP.
